title: Veolia Water Main Replacement- Webster Avenue
description:
NOTE: The work is being done by Veolia replacing the water main on Webster Avenue into the downtown. Veolia is a private water company licensed by the PSE, and the work was approved in their capital program. The City of New Rochelle's approval is limited to the street opening permit. They are required to restore the streets per the City's regulations. Road plates will be removed and affected areas paved following county inspection and the transfer of customer service lines from the old main to the new main. This process will take approximately one month to complete in the areas currently plated and requiring service transfers. The entirety of the work will be completed in 24-30 months.
